card.line: The Valley of Elah is a valley in Judah where Israel camped to face the Philistines, the place where David killed the giant Goliath.

moments.title: Israel camps for battle
moments.text: Saul and the men of Israel gathered in the Valley of Elah to get ready to fight the Philistines. The two armies stood on hills with the valley between them.

moments.title: David kills Goliath
moments.text: The priest Ahimelech later said that David had killed Goliath the Philistine in the Valley of Elah. This is the valley where the giant fell.
